faqs.question: Why do I need to share the pickup OTP?
faqs.answer: The driver asks for the OTP at pickup to confirm they are collecting the right package. Share it only with the driver assigned to your order.

faqs.question: When do I pay — at pickup or at drop?
faqs.answer: You choose on the booking screen. Pay at pickup if you are the sender, or at drop if the receiver will pay.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my order?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can cancel from the tracking screen until the package is picked up.

faqs.question: How do coupons work?
faqs.answer: Apply a coupon on the booking screen. The discount is taken off the fare before you book.

faqs.question: What items can't I send?
faqs.answer: Cash, jewellery, illegal goods, flammable or hazardous materials and live animals are not allowed.
